title: Engineering Excellence worklist
description: One artifact `engineering-excellence-worklist` containing `worklist.json`, uploaded by a repo's main-branch CI and read by the weekly audit. Per check, the worst items with where they are. Same envelope as the facets (engineering-excellence.schema.json) with `facet: "worklist"`. Rates and scores are 0..1 fractions. It never holds source code or secrets.

limit.description: The cap on `items` per check for this run.

checks.description: Every check is present. null means the check was not measured in this run: its report was absent or could not be read.

unreadable.description: Checks with a report that was present but could not be read, and `config` when quality.config.json is not valid (the defaults are used). A check with nothing else to read is null in `checks`.

mode.description: The check's mode: the quality.config.json section's for dead code, bundle, architecture and patterns; `ratchet` for the checks that are always enforced. An item may differ (see item.mode).

total.description: Items the check has, before the cap.

truncated.description: true when `total` is more than `items` holds.

sources.description: What the check was read from: `facet:<name>` or a report (`cobertura:api`, `cobertura:web`, `lcov`, `stryker`, `trivy`, `semgrep`, `knip`, `jscpd`, `steiger`, `trx`, `sarif`, `bundle-report`, `size-limit`).

rules.description: Dead code, architecture and patterns: per Knip issue type, Steiger rule (warnings) or analyzer rule, how many it has, how many its baseline allows (null without one) and whether it is over. Not capped.

items.description: Worst first within each kind; at most `limit`.

id.description: sha256 of check, rule, path and symbol, first 16 hex characters. It does not change when line numbers or values do.

rule.description: The tool's rule: `crap`, a CVE or misconfiguration id, a Semgrep check id, a Knip issue type, a Steiger rule, an analyzer rule id.

path.description: Repository-relative, forward slashes. null where the source names none (a scope, a failing architecture test, the bundle total).

line.description: The first line the item is on, when the report gives one.

symbol.description: A method, `scope/module`, a package, an export, the other file of a clone, a test, a bundle entry.

value.description: The item's own measure: a CRAP score, a line rate or mutation score (0..1), surviving mutants, a severity (CRITICAL, HIGH), findings of the rule at this path, duplicated lines, bytes.

threshold.description: The fixed bar `value` is judged against: the CRAP maximum, the scope's floor, 0 where none is tolerated, jscpd's minimum clone, the byte budget. null without one.

baseline.description: The recorded baseline the item's rule ratchets against, in the rule's unit: findings the rule may have (compare with detail.ruleCount), or the bundle's baseline bytes. null without one.

mode.description: `ratchet` when CI enforces this item today, `report` when it only measures it.

message.description: The tool's message on one line, at most 200 characters. Never source code.

detail.description: Small extras per kind: scope, module, cc, coverage, lines (up to 10), severity, level, analyzer, fixedVersion, installedVersion, fixable, ruleCount, overBaseline, otherPath, otherLine, clones.
